design_decisions.decision: Added DB_POOL_TIMEOUT_S (default 3) env var, also used as startup wait and connect_timeout; rejected a hardcoded constant (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Not in SPEC Sec 10.
404/405 codes not_found / method_not_allowed; any other HTTP status maps to http_NNN. Not in SPEC Sec 12.
Message containing NUL is a 422 (Postgres text cannot store it); rejected letting it surface as a 500.
queries.py functions borrow connections from db.connection() themselves, so routers never touch the pool; rejected passing a connection through the router.
Fail-fast via SystemExit(1) in the lifespan after an error log; rejected a pre-app check so the same path covers uvicorn and compose restarts. Traceback noise from uvicorn remains.
DB-down tests swap db._pool for a pool aimed at a dead port; rejected stopping containers.
Sync (def) routes with a sync pool, run in the threadpool; rejected async psycopg for simplicity.

Default DATABASE_URL is a localhost dev value so config works with no env; compose and CI set their own. Host ports in compose are overridable because 8000/5432/5433 were occupied by another project on this machine.
README.md left unchanged: it already has the three Day 1 endpoint rows and the error-code list (without not_found/method_not_allowed).
